props.title: In the next 20 minutes
props.markdown:
1. Read the four members of a planetary gearset.
2. Compute any of its ratios with a single equation.
3. Configure a 3D test bench, then a hoist drive for a customer.

props.alt: Front view of a planetary gearset: a copper sun gear in the centre, three steel planet gears on a blue carrier, all inside a dark ring gear.

props.label: Reduce
props.body: Ring held, the sun drives the carrier.

props.label: Speed up
props.body: Ring held, the carrier drives the sun.

props.label: Reverse
props.body: Carrier held, the sun drives the ring.
